reason: The repository presents a DeepSeek Harness bundle (confirmed by package.json and README) whose main user-facing role is to help plan and execute Atlas Cloud media workflows, with skills for image/video/audio/3D prompt/model planning and optional MCP execution tools for running those workflows. It is primarily a workflow-planning and execution plugin for media generation and depends on external Atlas Cloud APIs when execution is enabled.

summaries.zh: 这是一个面向 DeepSeek Harness 的插件包，提供图像、视频、音频与 3D 相关的技能与可选 Atlas Cloud MCP 工具，将创作需求转为模型选择、提示词与可执行参数。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness bundle offering image, video, audio, and 3D skills plus an optional Atlas Cloud MCP bridge, turning a media brief into model choices, prompts, and execution-ready parameters.

capabilities: Converts media briefs into model recommendations, prompts, and generation parameters
Provides optional MCP-backed execution hooks for Atlas Cloud operations such as listing models, upload, generation, and polling
Requires a user-supplied Atlas Cloud API key at execution time for billable API calls
